conditions.runtime: Integrated or dedicated logical server with JEM Rewards. Dedicated authentication and pre-choice protection remain a separate JEM Server contract.
conditions.implementation_assumption: One base entitlement per player and world. Existing recipients receive only the versioned exploration extension.

change.summary: Move the durable starter entitlement to universal JEM Rewards, add a spyglass and Paraglider, and retain the dedicated authentication/race combat guard.

modifiers.before: JEM Server issues the starter kit only while the dedicated SMP environment is active.

after.scope: Once per player and world on integrated and dedicated logical servers. Existing base recipients receive only the exploration extension.
after.currency: Existing20Gold grant, finite funding and receipt unchanged; no money regrant.
after.delivery: JEM Rewards take-only container; unclaimed remainder remains journaled and never drops or equips over worn items.
after.durability: Preserve the original base source ID, import completed and interrupted jem_starter_kits.dat rows, honor matching legacy player receipts and use a versioned exploration-extension receipt.
after.failure: Missing required native item/storage failure refuses completion; disconnect on unacknowledged inventory persistence failure.
after.backpack_replacement: Exact empty unissued starter backpack NBT IDs are replaced before reward transfer. Delivered/custom-data inventories are not converted.

after.condition: IdentityPolicy unresolved OR RaceApi.get(server, canonical account) has no effective race.
after.incoming: Cancel attack/hurt/damage/death for the protected player.
after.outgoing: Deny melee and damage whose resolved projectile/owned source belongs to the protected player.
after.end: Immediately when verification AND effective race choice exist; reopening GUI cannot restore protection.
after.owners: Consume IdentityPolicy/RaceApi/HostedEncounterApi damageOwner; no duplicate auth/race record.
after.status: Source in testing; protection checks not yet exercised.

cause.owner: JEMRewards ModpackStarterKit and PendingRewardContainer; JEMServer StarterWelcome retains only dedicated pre-choice protection

rationale.purpose: Provide the starter kit in singleplayer and multiplayer, add the requested exploration items, and prevent repeat grants during the ownership migration.
rationale.decision_source: User requested modpack-level starter delivery plus a spyglass and glider on 2026-11-09. The earlier dedicated protection contract remains unchanged.
rationale.user_requested: Starter kit available on server and singleplayer, with a spyglass and glider.
rationale.codex_choices: Use universal JEM Rewards, preserve the original base source ID, give existing recipients only a versioned exploration extension and migrate legacy server journals.

introduced.summary: Source starter kit and incoming/outgoing auth/race shield; once-per-account and cooked-beef choices announced by Codex. In testing, no runtime/delivery/deployment claim.

history.summary: Source starter kit and incoming/outgoing auth/race shield; once-per-account and cooked-beef choices announced by Codex. In testing, no runtime/delivery/deployment claim.

ENGINEERING v2 split the starter owner into persistent entitlement transitions, delivery/reconciliation and native player-file persistence. Current causes now name those exact owners; retired StarterKitData paths remain historical evidence. Entitlements, saved IDs, receipt/replay contracts and record status are unchanged.
history.previous_owner: JEMServer StarterWelcome and StarterKitData; existing native player save accessor

history.summary: User replaces Backpacked with native Sophisticated Backpacks. Preserve once-only account quantity and receipts, substitute the unissued empty starter backpack only.
Move new starter issuance from dedicated JEM Server to universal JEM Rewards, preserve legacy receipts and add one spyglass plus one Paraglider.

relations: JEM Rewards owns starter item issuance and durable claims
JEM Server owns dedicated authentication and pre-choice protection only
IdentityPolicy owns verification and Roles owns effective race
impacts.notes: No gameplay launch or player acceptance claim. Existing recipients receive only the exploration extension. Full-inventory remainder is retained in JEM Rewards.
unresolved: Fresh artifact delivery and integrated/dedicated runtime acceptance remain separate execution steps.
